arguments.value: Beike Internet (Beijing) Security Technology Co., Ltd. and Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. agree to cooperate on search and related promotion services. Beike must integrate Baidu search into its Kingsoft Navigation/Cheetah Browser products, show Baidu’s search box, follow Baidu’s cooperation rules, protect Baidu’s trademarks and technology, and not cooperate with Qihoo 360 without Baidu’s prior consent. Baidu must provide the search service, traffic data, and revenue sharing under the agreement, and may enforce its union cooperation rules and adjust service terms with notice. The cooperation term is two years, from May 1, 2013 to April 30, 2015, unless the parties renew it. The agreement is governed by PRC laws. The contract also requires confidentiality, sets breach and termination rules, and says disputes will first be handled by consultation or mediation and then submitted to the court in the location of Party B if unresolved.
